name: UnitFuelDTO
description: UnitFuelDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

fuelCode.description: The type of fuel which a UNIT is capable or will be capable of combusting.

indicatorCode.description: Code that indicates fuel or control type.

ozoneSeasonIndicator.description: Indicator that FUEL is used during ozone season.

demGCV.description: Demonstration method to qualify for monthly GCV fuel sampling.

demSO2.description: Demonstration method to qualify for daily fuel sampling for percent sulfur.

beginDate.description: Date on which a relationship or an activity began.

endDate.description: Date on which a relationship or an activity ended.

actualOrProjectCode.description: Indicator of whether the begin date for the fuel type is an actual date or a projected date.

sulfurContent.description: The percent sulfur content of the fuel, by weight.

userId.description: The user name of the person or process that created the record if the Update Date is empty.  Otherwise this is the user name of the person or process that made the last update.

updateDate.description: Date of the last record update.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
